root_cause.text: The `nft_ct_expect_obj_eval` function in the netfilter nft_ct subsystem causes a reference leak by allocating an expectation object without subsequently calling `nf_ct_expect_put` to release the acquired reference.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states that `nft_ct_expect_obj_eval()` "allocates an expectation and may call nf_ct_expect_related(), but never drops its local reference," and the patch diff confirms the fix by adding `nf_ct_expect_put(exp)` immediately after the `nf_ct_expect_related()` call.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a reference count leak by releasing the nf_ct_expect object after evaluation.
intent_record.what: Added a call to nf_ct_expect_put(exp) at the end of the nft_ct_expect_obj_eval function body.
intent_record.how: Decrements the reference count of the connection tracking expectation object, ensuring the allocated memory is freed and preventing a resource leak after nf_ct_expect_related completes.
